environmentEvidence.separateRepl: Owner confirmed this WFM staging branch is in a separate Repl.
environmentEvidence.inviteOnlyDeployment: PENDING legacy Replit invite-only release requirement. Railway staging is deployed behind its approved access gateway, with no public API or socket domains. The false flag is preserved pending an explicit release-policy decision.
environmentEvidence.separateStagingDatabase: The owner-confirmed isolated Railway staging database is used by the private staging API. Live profile writes and restoration occurred only through the protected staging gateway.
environmentEvidence.stagingOnlyAuthentication: Three browser contexts authenticated against staging Development Clerk: two sessions for one existing approved account and one for a distinct existing approved account. No users were created.
environmentEvidence.productionDataUntouched: Only staging was pushed and tested. No Production deployment, key, account or player-data mutation was performed.

latestFrozenWorkspaceQualityCheck.scope: Local workspace only. No application source, Clerk configuration, Railway configuration, or Production settings changed in this check; staging promotion evidence remains a separate gate.

previewGameplay.reason: Time expired with both integrity bars tied.

latestNetworkHarness.scope: Synthetic automated test only; not a real-network or ten-human match.

app.failureSummary: Earlier gateway deployments failed the STAGING_ACCESS_CODE single-line and length validation.

api.failureSummary: Earlier API deployments lacked DATABASE_URL and exited before the readiness endpoint responded.

socket.failureSummary: An earlier socket deployment lacked WING_ALLOWED_ORIGINS and exited before the healthcheck responded.

currentStagingRailwayHealth.interpretation: The failed attempts are historical config/healthcheck failures followed by successful deployments. All current services are online, but Railway still reports the failures in its 24-hour window; this is not a workspace build failure or proof that remaining release evidence passed.

latestStagingMobileSmoke.scope: Limited no-account staging browser smoke only. Does not complete the invite-only policy requirement, authenticated progression checks, physical-device checks, economy checks, or multiplayer release evidence.

latestLiveMultiplayerRoomSmoke.transport: WSS through protected Railway staging gateway
latestLiveMultiplayerRoomSmoke.scope: Temporary protocol clients in one unique live staging room through the protected gateway. No match completion, browser invite flow, physical-device, reward, or restart behavior was tested.

latestLiveTenClientMatch.transport: WSS through protected Railway staging gateway
latestLiveTenClientMatch.scope: Ten scripted protocol clients completed a live staging match after two controlled disconnect/reconnect events. This verifies server-level staging behavior, not human gameplay, browser UI, physical-device network impairment, or reward persistence.

previousStagingSocketRestartCheck.restartMode: Railway in-place restart of the existing deployment
previousStagingSocketRestartCheck.scope: Authorized staging-only restart during an active two-client match. Clients did not receive the restart notice and closed abnormally; the service recovered, the old reconnect token was rejected, and a new room started. Reward claiming was not tested.

latestLocalSocketSignalComparison.wrapperSignal: SIGTERM sent to the pnpm process; no client shutdown notice or WebSocket close was observed within 10 seconds
latestLocalSocketSignalComparison.interpretation: The pnpm wrapper did not close sockets locally, while direct Node did; a local gateway-plus-socket test also passed. Live results differ by harness: a two-client raw Railway probe closed both clients with 1006 and no notice, while a later one-pilot browser displayed the server-restart message. Multi-pilot delivery remains unresolved.

latestLocalGatewayShutdownCheck.scope: Local staging gateway proxy with a direct Node socket process; SIGTERM delivered the interruption notice to both clients and the proxy forwarded close code 4002. This does not establish Railway service-restart behavior.

latestStagingSocketRestartCheck.restartMode: Railway in-place restart after successful direct-Node start-command deployment
latestStagingSocketRestartCheck.scope: After an explicitly authorized staging-only start-command update and successful deployment, an active two-client match was interrupted by an in-place Railway restart. Neither client received the interruption notice; both closed with 1006. The service recovered and a fresh room started. No reward claim was attempted.

latestStagingBrowserRestartCheck.scope: An approved staging account reached an active one-pilot browser match. After the staging socket restart, the UI returned to the menu and showed its server_restart no-rewards message. This proves the visible message for one browser pilot, not delivery to all pilots; an earlier two-client raw protocol run observed close code 1006 and no notice.

latestStagingBrowserFreshRoomCheck.scope: One authenticated staging browser started an online room, received the server_restart no-rewards message after the staging socket restart, then used Create New Room to generate a different room and start another match. Room codes were not recorded. This establishes the browser recovery flow for one pilot, not all-player restart notification. The online-room path does not call the separate server-authorized Strike claim API.

latestStagingAccountAndRoomUiCheck.scope: Protected staging only, using two existing approved accounts. /api/world and /api/market returned data for both accounts. A profile query carrying the other account's userId returned the authenticated caller's profile; a profile action carrying a foreign userId was rejected with HTTP 400. The first full-profile comparison differed; a repeat stability check and a second before/after comparison around the rejected write were stable. Browser room-code invite, separate team assignment, the host readiness gate, both-pilot readiness, and match start passed with three canvases per browser. No market trade, new account, reward claim, or Production change was made. This does not certify physical-device sync or world-state cross-account mutations.

latestStagingSharedMarketTradeCheck.scope: The secure fresh-code submissions did not establish either Clerk session; both browser contexts remained at needs_client_trust. No market endpoint was called and no trade, account, market, or Production data was changed.

railwayBackend.classification: Historical Production hosting audit; not current staging or workspace-quality status. Current read-only inventory follows.
railwayBackend.scope: API and WebSocket backend; frontend remains on Replit

latestAuthenticatedRewardFlight.scope: One staging skirmish and same-session reload only; broader tests below remain pending.

latestLiveProfileSync.scope: Real protected-staging requests and automatic visible UI refresh, without reader reload or synthetic refresh events. Independent browser storage contexts on one host, not distinct physical devices. This does not certify separate inventory/history endpoints or rejected cross-account writes.
